independent_checker.implementation_scope: Separate OpenSSL EC_POINT operations from Rust field/group code. Exact fixed fixture/seed binding,canonical coordinates/scalar,nonidentity points,independent even-y target reconstruction,explicit BN-bit point-double/add loop forrP=O andkP=Q. independent_checker.limits: C checker is a post-run point audit,not a solver/full relation verifier. It does not independently prove primality,Hasse cardinality,linear dependence,full relation correctness,work counters,timing or execution history. Its target search has a256-position validator bound; actual fixed targets pass it. Native replay separately rebuilds bases/relations and scalar dependency but shares the solver arithmetic library.

negative_causes.wrong_scalar: Replacek by(k+1)%r with unchanged target. Every raw stderr is exactly VERIFY SCALAR kP=Q,so rejection is at the scalar equation rather than range/fixture parsing.
negative_causes.consistent_substitution: ReplaceQy byp-Qy andk byr-k. Nonzerok/y ensure nontrivial canonical negation. Positive rP=O andkP=Q make this pair algebraically consistent,but every raw stderr is exactly VERIFY BINDING public target. Checker rejects the changed public instance before its scalar multiplication; this is an instance-binding control,not a claim that the negative pair was separately passed through scalar verification.
